key_insight: Detonation-spraying parameters control the roughness, thickness, and hydrophobicity of titanium-dioxide-based metal–ceramic coatings.
engineering_relevance: Selecting nozzle travel speed and spray distance can help engineers tune coating geometry and maximize water repellency.
method: Evaluate coating roughness, thickness, and water contact angle.
Derive predictive relationships and identify conditions for maximum hydrophobicity.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports inverse-power relationships between nozzle travel speed and roughness/thickness, and parabolic relationships between spray distance and roughness/contact angle.
watch_item: The abstract provides no numerical parameter ranges, fit accuracy, or durability results, limiting assessment of transferability to production.
paper_title: Surface Characteristics of Titanium Based Coatings Obtained by Detonation Spraying Under Various Process Conditions
